description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class for the LeaveEntitlementDao, specifically testing the getLeaveBalance method under various scenarios. It uses mock objects to simulate dependencies and verifies the correctness of leave balance calculations based on different date ranges and entity configurations.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDaoGetLeaveBalanceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class to validate the getLeaveBalance method of LeaveEntitlementDao across various scenarios, ensuring correctness in different date ranges and entitlement configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of LeaveEntitlementDao and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalance
methods.description: Performs a series of assertions to verify that getLeaveBalance returns correct LeaveBalance objects for multiple date ranges and employee/leave type combinations.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithUnlinkedLeave
methods.description: Tests getLeaveBalance behavior when handling unlinked leave periods, verifying that the balance calculations exclude or account for unlinked leave as appropriate.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedLeaveWhenAfterPeriod
methods.description: Verifies leave balance calculation excluding unlinked leave when the specified date range is after the unlinked leave period.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedBeforePeriod
methods.description: Ensures correct balance when excluding unlinked leave that occurs before the specified date range.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedLeave
methods.description: Checks behavior when the getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance method returns null, indicating no unlinked leave to exclude.
